authoringPolicy.zh: 以橫握雙面反膠為主要教學情境，左手動作按持拍側鏡像。五階段、錯誤診斷和練習為本專區編寫；練習數字是可調整的目標，並非職業標準或比賽使用率。來源支持列出的規則與技術要點，職業例子另註本人自述或報導觀察。影片與遊戲姿勢不能量出三維角度、旋轉量或力量；動畫用來說明流程，不是對選手動作的精確複製。
authoringPolicy.en: The main teaching context is a shakehand player using inverted rubber on both sides. Mirror the racket side for left-handers. The five-phase framework, diagnostics and drills are authored for this academy; numerical practice goals are adjustable, not professional benchmarks or usage statistics. Sources support the stated rules and technical points, while professional examples distinguish athlete accounts from reporting. Broadcast footage and game poses do not establish 3D angles, spin or force. Animation illustrates a sequence rather than precisely reproducing an athlete.

title.zh: 發球：合法拋球、旋轉與第三板
title.en: Serve: a legal toss, spin and the third ball

intro.zh: 先練能重複的落點，再增加旋轉與假動作。好發球要讓你知道下一板大概會收到甚麼；直接得分只是其中一種結果。以下以橫握正手下旋為起點，左右手鏡像練習。
intro.en: Begin with repeatable placement, then add spin and deceptive racket motion. A useful serve gives you a reasonable idea of the next ball; an outright winner is only one possible result. Start with a shakehand forehand backspin serve and mirror the movement for the other playing hand.

suitable.zh: 你掌握發球權時；先分開練短下旋、短不轉、快速長球，再組合。
suitable.en: Use when serving. Practise short backspin, short no-spin and a fast long serve separately before combining them.

suitable.zh: 短球以對方不接時可再跳一次判斷，不能只看第一落點是否靠網。
suitable.en: A short serve would bounce again on the receiver’s court if left untouched. Its first bounce alone does not define its length.

text.zh: 自由手靜止、手掌攤開，球自然放在掌上。從開始到擊球，球都在檯面以上、端線後方，並讓接發者看見。選好目標與第三板預案，雙腳穩住，肩頸放鬆。
text.en: Rest the ball freely on the open palm of the stationary free hand. From the start until contact, keep it above the surface, behind the end line and visible to the receiver. Choose a target and third-ball intention, settle the feet and relax the shoulders.

text.zh: 近乎垂直、不加旋地拋球，離掌後上升至少十六公分。持拍手短距離引拍，眼睛跟球；球一離掌，自由臂與手就移出球與球網間的空間，等球下降。
text.en: Toss nearly vertically without imparting spin so the ball rises at least 16 cm after leaving the palm. Prepare a compact backswing while tracking it. As soon as it is projected, remove the free arm and hand from the space between ball and net; wait for its descent.

text.zh: 等球下降，在端線後、檯面以上觸球；離掌到擊球前不能碰到其他東西。下旋擦球後下方；不轉可減少擦球、增加正面接觸。一次只改拋高、面角或力道其中一項。
text.en: Strike the descending ball behind the end line and above the surface, without any intervening contact after release. Brush its lower rear area for backspin; reduce brushing and use more direct contact for no-spin. Change only one of toss height, angle or force at a time.

text.zh: 拍子沿原方向短促收完，球先跳自己的檯面，再跳對方檯面。短球觀察過網高度與第二跳；長球看是否深而低，不把大隨揮誤當強旋轉。
text.en: Finish briefly along the chosen path. The ball must bounce on your court before the receiver’s. For a short serve, inspect net clearance and the next bounce; for a long serve, inspect low, deep placement. A large finish does not prove strong spin.

text.zh: 發完立即恢復正常握拍，轉向對手，拍回身前。短球準備進檯、長回球準備讓出揮拍空間；先看接發再啟動，不把預案變成盲猜。
text.en: Return to the normal playing grip, face the opponent and bring the racket in front. Be ready to step in for a short return or make room for a long one. Read the receive before moving; a plan is not a commitment to guess blindly.

text.zh: 自由手負責穩定拋球；持拍手放鬆加速、觸球瞬間才收緊，握拍變化要能迅速復原。
text.en: The free hand controls the toss. Accelerate a relaxed racket hand and firm it briefly at contact; any serving grip must be easy to restore.

text.zh: 足底有支撐，發球後能向前或橫向起步；不要發完仍側身站死。
text.en: Maintain a supported base that permits a forward or sideways first step. Do not remain locked in a side-on serving pose.

text.zh: 髖部配合小幅轉動控制節奏，不靠猛蹲猛起製造旋轉。
text.en: A small hip turn supports rhythm. Avoid using a large squat-and-rise as a substitute for racket brushing.

text.zh: 肩線穩定，持拍肩不聳起；軀幹和自由臂都不能遮住擊球。
text.en: Keep the shoulders settled without shrugging the racket side. Neither the trunk nor free arm may conceal contact.

symptom.zh: 短球常常變半出台。
symptom.en: The intended short serve drifts half-long.

cause.zh: 接觸太厚或速度太大。
cause.en: Contact is too direct or too fast.

fix.zh: 固定拋球，減小前推；留球不接，檢查第二跳。
fix.en: Keep the toss fixed, reduce forward impulse and leave the ball untouched to check the second bounce.

symptom.zh: 同一發球忽高忽低。
symptom.en: The same serve alternates between high and low.

cause.zh: 拋球向身體跑，擊球位置漂移。
cause.en: The toss drifts toward the body and changes contact location.

fix.zh: 先只拋接十球，讓下降路線可重複，再加入拍子。
fix.en: First toss and catch ten balls on a repeatable descending path, then add racket contact.

symptom.zh: 發得好卻接不上第三板。
symptom.en: A good serve is followed by a missed third ball.

cause.zh: 欣賞發球或握拍未復原。
cause.en: You watch the serve or fail to restore the grip.

fix.zh: 每次發球後做一次還原步，搭配伙伴接發。
fix.en: Add a recovery step after every serve and practise with a partner returning it.

steps.zh: 在對方檯面放短、深兩個寬目標，先各發十球。
steps.en: Mark broad short and deep target areas on the receiver’s court; serve ten balls to each.

steps.zh: 第二輪交替長短，伙伴先不接，再開始接發。
steps.en: Alternate lengths in the next round, first without a receiver, then with a receiving partner.

success.zh: 練習目標：每組至少八球合法進區；短球有第二跳，並完成還原。
success.en: Practice target: Aim for at least eight legal target serves per set; short balls should have a second bounce and every serve should include recovery.

steps.zh: 發短下旋，伙伴隨機擺短或劈長。
steps.en: Serve short backspin; the partner randomly returns short or pushes long.

steps.zh: 你先報長短，再選進檯控制或拉起，繼續打第五板。
steps.en: Call short or long, choose a table return or opening loop and continue to the fifth ball.

success.zh: 練習目標：十次中八次判長短正確，第三板後仍能接下一球。
success.en: Practice target: Read the length correctly on eight of ten sequences and remain ready for the ball after the third shot.

use.zh: 短下旋與不轉配對，讓接發面角難固定；偶爾長球利用對手過度前傾。
use.en: Pair short backspin with no-spin to challenge a fixed receiving angle; use an occasional long serve against excessive forward commitment.

risk.zh: 長球給對手完整攻擊空間；模仿職業假動作仍必須保留可見觸球。
risk.en: A long serve gives the receiver room to attack. Deceptive professional motion still requires visible, legal contact.

notes.zh: 二○一九年本人訪談把每次發球練習的任務說得很清楚：高度、旋轉與讓對手難判斷；這是當年的自述，並非本專區量測。
notes.en: In a 2019 interview, Lin described setting a specific serving task, including height, spin and difficult-to-read spin. This is his account from that period, not a measurement made for this academy.

scope.zh: 下旋發球基本準備與短距離觸球。
scope.en: Basic setup and compact contact for a backspin serve.

sources.title: Butterfly — Lin Yun-Ju on serving (2019)

scope.zh: 本人談練習任務與發球意圖。
scope.en: Lin’s own account of serving tasks and intentions.

title.zh: 接發球：讀長短，再選攻或控
title.en: Receive: read length, then choose attack or control

intro.zh: 接發不是猜一個招式，而是把長短、旋轉與可觸球位置依序確認。先讓第四板有準備，再要求接發直接造成壓力；同一短球可能擺短、劈長或擰拉，選擇取決於球質與對手。
intro.en: Receiving is a sequence of judgments about length, spin and reachable contact, rather than a guess at one stroke. Build a prepared fourth ball before demanding an immediate advantage. The same short serve may invite a short push, a deep push or a flick, depending on its quality and the opponent.

suitable.zh: 短球會在你半檯再跳；長球一次跳後離檯，半出台要看完整路線。
suitable.en: A short serve would bounce again on your half; a long one leaves after one bounce. Judge a half-long serve from its full path.

suitable.zh: 回球下網、出界或向側邊偏，可提供旋轉判斷的修正線索。
suitable.en: Net, long and sideways misses provide feedback for refining your spin reading.

text.zh: 拍在身前、重心可進可退。看發球真正觸球的一瞬，再追球路；別被最後誇張隨揮牽走。先預備兩種回法，保留改選空間。
text.en: Keep the racket in front and the base ready to move in or out. Watch actual service contact, then follow the ball rather than the exaggerated finish. Prepare two plausible returns and leave room to change your choice.

text.zh: 判短才踏入、判長就讓出引拍空間。短球小引拍，長下旋稍降拍；未看清旋轉時選較寬目標，不把拍伸得太遠才開始調面。
text.en: Step in when the ball is short and create backswing room when it is long. Use a small preparation over the table and lower the racket for long backspin. With uncertain spin, choose a broader target; do not wait until fully stretched to set the angle.

text.zh: 等球在己方檯面跳起才打。下旋需要承托或向上擦，側上旋要抑制上彈並補償側偏。少旋球不能照重下旋一路托；先用中等力量找穩定接觸。
text.en: Contact only after the bounce on your court. Backspin calls for support or upward brushing; side-topspin requires control of the upward rebound and sideways deflection. Do not lift a no-spin ball as if it were heavy backspin. Start with moderate force and repeatable contact.

text.zh: 控制球縮短隨揮，攻擊球也留住平衡。短接發看高度與長度，長接發看是否壓到深區或身體中路；進檯攻擊不要一路向前撞檯。
text.en: Keep a controlled return’s finish short and preserve balance even when attacking. Check height and length on a short return, or depth and elbow placement on a long one. Do not let a table attack carry you into the table.

text.zh: 進檯後立即退出可打長球的位置，拍回兩手之間。你劈長通常要準備對方起板；你擰拉則要準備快擋或反拉，不能把第二板當最後一板。
text.en: After stepping in, regain a position from which you can play a long ball and reset the racket between the hands. A deep push often invites an opening loop; a flick may bring a fast block or counter. The second ball is rarely the final ball.

text.zh: 握力有彈性，面角在觸球前設定；避免接觸當下大翻拍。
text.en: Keep grip pressure adaptable and set the angle before contact rather than flipping the face at impact.

text.zh: 小調整步保留身前空間；跨進去還要能跨回來。
text.en: Use small adjustments to preserve space in front. Every step into the table needs a route back out.

text.zh: 髖部降低讓眼睛靠近球高，不以彎腰伸手取代移動。
text.en: Lower through the hips to bring the eyes nearer ball height; do not replace footwork with bending and reaching.

text.zh: 肩膀平衡，胸口不因想打大角而提早扭走。
text.en: Keep the shoulders balanced and do not turn the chest away early to chase a wide angle.

symptom.zh: 相似發球時上時下。
symptom.en: Similar serves produce alternating net and long misses.

cause.zh: 只看動作外形，忽略接觸及不轉變化。
cause.en: You read the gesture rather than contact and miss the no-spin variation.

fix.zh: 伙伴交替同落點下旋與不轉，先報旋轉再接。
fix.en: Have a partner alternate backspin and no-spin to the same target; call the spin before returning.

symptom.zh: 短球勉強碰到，回球卻冒高。
symptom.en: You barely reach a short ball and pop it up.

cause.zh: 身體留在後方，手腕代替整個位移。
cause.en: The body stays back and the wrist compensates for the missing approach.

fix.zh: 先靠腳縮短距離，再用小拍幅控制。
fix.en: Close the distance with the feet, then control it with a small stroke.

symptom.zh: 接發上台但第四板總慢。
symptom.en: The receive lands but the fourth ball is always late.

cause.zh: 進檯後停住或只顧回球。
cause.en: You stop after stepping in or watch only your return.

fix.zh: 固定加一板隨機回球，驗收還原而非只算接發。
fix.en: Always add a random next ball and assess recovery as well as the receive.

steps.zh: 伙伴用同一站位發短或長，下旋先固定。
steps.en: The partner serves short or long from one position, initially keeping backspin fixed.

steps.zh: 報長短，短球控制、長球拉起，成功後才混旋轉。
steps.en: Call the length, control the short ball and loop the long one; add mixed spin after this is reliable.

success.zh: 練習目標：十球判對八球，沒有未跳先打；接完仍能碰到第四板。
success.en: Practice target: Read eight of ten correctly, never hit before the receiving bounce and remain able to play the fourth ball.

steps.zh: 選擺短或劈長其中一種，伙伴正常第三板。
steps.en: Choose either a short or deep push; the partner plays a normal third ball.

steps.zh: 接完回到可處理下一球的位置，交換發接角色。
steps.en: Recover into a position that covers the next ball, then swap serving and receiving roles.

success.zh: 練習目標：連做六段到第四板，記錄失敗來自讀球、接觸還是還原。
success.en: Practice target: Complete six sequences through the fourth ball and label failures as reading, contact or recovery errors.

use.zh: 對手等你攻常用斜線，可改低短球或深中路；攻擊與控制互相增加威脅。
use.en: If the server waits for your usual diagonal attack, vary with a low short return or a deep elbow ball. Attack and control make each other more threatening.

risk.zh: 盲目全攻容易送分；只保守回中央又讓對手第三板舒服。
risk.en: Attacking every serve blindly wastes points; sending every controlled return comfortably to the middle also helps the server.

notes.zh: 二○二三年本人說，遇到對手等待擰拉、或正手邊線短球難擰時，會改用擺短或推球。變化是有來球條件的選擇。
notes.en: In 2023, Lin said he switches to a short return or push when the opponent anticipates his flick or a serve near the forehand sideline makes flicking difficult. The variation is tied to conditions.

sources.title: Butterfly / Larry Hodges — How To Return Different Serves (2026)

scope.en: Length definitions and receiving options against different spins.

scope.en: Initiative and neutralisation as receiving goals.

scope.zh: 本人談何時從擰拉改用控制球。
scope.en: Lin’s explanation of when to vary away from a flick.

title.zh: 正手：把空間、轉體與觸球連起來
title.en: Forehand: connect space, rotation and contact

intro.zh: 正手不是把拍子揮到最大，而是讓球在身前、身體仍有平衡時被加速。先用中速上旋建立連續，再練下旋起板與高球進攻。來球越急，引拍越要精簡；左右手把持拍側互換即可。
intro.en: A forehand accelerates the ball in front of a balanced body; it is not a competition for the largest swing. Build repeated medium-speed topspin first, then add an opening against backspin and an attack on a high ball. Faster incoming balls call for shorter preparation. Mirror the racket side for a left-hander.

suitable.zh: 出台上旋或少旋球可前上方迎擊；長下旋需要更多向上摩擦。
suitable.en: Meet a long topspin or low-spin ball forward and upward; a long backspin ball needs a greater upward brushing component.

suitable.zh: 台內低短球沒有完整引拍空間，改用推、擺或挑，不硬套後場拉球。
suitable.en: A low short ball limits the backswing. Use a push, short return or flick rather than forcing a full off-table loop.

text.zh: 先移到持拍側有揮拍空間的位置，膝髖微屈、拍在身前。眼睛跟著跳起的球，胸口可轉動；別讓球貼住肚子才決定用正手。
text.en: Move so the racket side has working space. Flex the knees and hips and keep the racket in front. Follow the bounce with the eyes and leave the trunk free to rotate; do not wait until the ball reaches the stomach to choose a forehand.

text.zh: 髖與肩小幅轉向持拍側，拍靠近預定觸球高度。下旋稍降拍，上旋少向下繞；手臂鬆、肘保留彎曲，揮拍前不把肩拉成極限。
text.en: Turn the hips and shoulders slightly toward the racket side and prepare near the intended contact height. Lower the racket more for backspin and less for topspin. Keep the arm relaxed and elbow flexed without stretching the shoulder to its limit.

text.zh: 由足底支撐配合轉體，手臂帶拍向前上方，在身前外側接球。上旋可較向前，下旋增加向上擦；先固定面角與接觸位置，再加速。
text.en: Use a supported base and body turn to drive the racket forward and upward into contact in front and to the racket side. Use a more forward path against topspin and more upward brushing against backspin. Stabilise face angle and contact before adding speed.

text.zh: 沿擊球方向自然收拍，肘可彎曲但不勒到頸旁。力道足夠就開始減速；近檯收短，中距離才放大，頭部不要跟拍猛抬。
text.en: Let the racket finish along the stroke with a flexing elbow without crowding the neck. Decelerate once the useful stroke is complete. Shorten the finish near the table and enlarge it only with space and time; do not lift the head with the racket.

text.zh: 拍回胸前、重量回到可再起步的位置，同時看對手回拍。下一球可能反手或中路，不沿上一板一直轉；正手打完也要保留兩邊防守。
text.en: Reset the racket in front of the chest and return to a base that can move again while reading the opponent. The next ball may be a backhand or elbow ball, so stop continuing the previous rotation and restore coverage of both sides.

text.zh: 握拍不持續死緊；觸球加速後鬆回，擦球與撞球比例按來球調整。
text.en: Avoid continuous maximum grip pressure. Release it after acceleration and vary brushing versus direct contact with the incoming ball.

text.zh: 先調距離再揮，支撐腳能承受轉體；不要靠後仰避開深球。
text.en: Adjust distance before swinging and keep a base that supports turning. Do not solve a deep ball merely by leaning backward.

text.zh: 髖轉與手臂同一節奏，不做腰先轉完、拍子才追上的兩段動作。
text.en: Coordinate hip rotation and arm action rather than completing the body turn before the racket follows.

text.zh: 肩放鬆並跟髖轉，非持拍手協助平衡；不把手臂甩過身體中央太遠。
text.en: Relax the shoulders and let them turn with the hips. Use the free arm for balance and avoid sweeping far across the body.

symptom.zh: 球被擠住，直線很難打。
symptom.en: Contact feels cramped and down-the-line placement is difficult.

cause.zh: 球到身旁太深，空間不足。
cause.en: Contact is too deep beside the body.

fix.zh: 提早移腳，把預定觸球放回身前，不用加大甩腕補救。
fix.en: Adjust the feet earlier and restore contact in front rather than adding a last-second wrist throw.

symptom.zh: 下旋一拉就下網。
symptom.en: The opening loop against backspin hits the net.

cause.zh: 拍路太水平，擦球加速不足。
cause.en: The path is too horizontal or brushing acceleration is insufficient.

fix.zh: 先降姿勢，用中速向上擦到大目標，再逐步增加向前速度。
fix.en: Lower the setup and brush upward at medium speed toward a large target before adding forward speed.

symptom.zh: 第一球有力，第二球來不及。
symptom.en: The first forehand is strong but the second is late.

cause.zh: 引拍和收拍過大，打完站直。
cause.en: Preparation and finish are too large and you stand up after contact.

fix.zh: 縮短拍幅，練連續兩球而非單球強打。
fix.en: Shorten the stroke and practise pairs of balls rather than isolated hard shots.

steps.zh: 固定斜線，先用舒服節奏對拉十球。
steps.en: Rally diagonally at a comfortable pace for ten balls.

steps.zh: 維持同一落點，稍加速；失衡就退回上一速度。
steps.en: Keep the target fixed and increase speed slightly; return to the previous pace if balance is lost.

success.zh: 練習目標：連續三段各十球，最後一球後仍能還原；不以最快速度作唯一成績。
success.en: Practice target: Complete three ten-ball sequences and recover after the final ball. Maximum speed is not the only measure.

steps.zh: 伙伴先推長下旋，你拉到寬斜線區。
steps.en: The partner pushes long backspin; open toward a broad diagonal target.

steps.zh: 伙伴再擋回上旋，第二板縮短引拍並向前迎。
steps.en: The partner blocks back with topspin; shorten the next preparation and meet it more forward.

success.zh: 練習目標：十段成功八段兩球連接，能說明第二球為何不照第一球向上拉。
success.en: Practice target: Connect both balls in eight of ten sequences and explain why the second stroke should not copy the first upward opening.

use.zh: 先以旋轉壓住回球，再找高球加速；對手站偏時打空位，站穩時可壓持拍肘。
use.en: Use spin to build pressure, then accelerate a higher ball. Play into open space when the opponent is displaced, or the playing elbow when settled.

risk.zh: 側身搶正手會空出另一邊；低球一律全力前撞，過網容錯很小。
risk.en: Pivoting for a forehand leaves the other side open. Driving every low ball flat gives little net margin.

notes.zh: 二○二四至二○二五年本人教學強調身前觸球，以及腿、髖、手協調。對下旋也保留向前力量，不能只把球向上抬。
notes.en: In his 2024–2025 instruction, Fan emphasised contact in front and coordination of legs, hips and hand. His backspin opening also includes forward force rather than only lifting upward.

sources.title: Butterfly — Basic forehand topspin (2022)

scope.zh: 正手上旋基本動作及還原。
scope.en: Basic forehand topspin mechanics and recovery.

sources.title: Butterfly — Fan Zhendong: forehand against a long ball (2024)

scope.zh: 本人談身前觸球與協調。
scope.en: Fan on contact in front and coordinated movement.

sources.title: Butterfly — Fan Zhendong: forehand against a push (2025)

scope.zh: 本人談下旋起板的上下與前後力量。
scope.en: Fan on upward and forward components against backspin.

title.zh: 反手：身前空間與近檯銜接
title.en: Backhand: front-body space and close-table continuity

intro.zh: 反手用較小的引拍也能製造速度，前提是肘、拍與身體之間有空間。把擋、快帶、起下旋分開練，別用同一面角應付所有球。職業選手的手腕口訣建立在成熟基本姿勢上。
intro.en: A backhand can generate speed with compact preparation if there is space between the elbow, racket and body. Practise the block, counter and backspin opening separately instead of using one face angle for everything. A professional’s wrist cue assumes a developed basic stance.

suitable.zh: 身前或反手側長上旋，時間足可快帶；高速低球可先擋住。
suitable.en: Use it for long topspin in front or to the backhand side. Counter with time available, or block a fast low ball.

suitable.zh: 長下旋可起板；短下旋用台內擰或推，不能將拍降到檯下硬拉。
suitable.en: Open against long backspin. Use a table flick or push against short backspin rather than forcing a below-table preparation.

text.zh: 雙腳支撐、髖略低，持拍肘在身前而非貼肋。讓球到來時拍子能在胸腹前工作；中路球先微移，不等撞身才把肘拉開。
text.en: Keep a supported, lowered base and the racket elbow in front rather than pinned to the ribs. Leave a working space in front of the torso. Adjust early for an elbow ball instead of opening the elbow only when crowded.

text.zh: 拍小幅向內收，前臂與手腕共同準備。上旋只需短引拍，下旋可略降拍並屈膝；肩不向後大拉，肘也不鎖成完全不動。
text.en: Draw the racket inward briefly with the forearm and wrist preparing together. Use a short backswing for topspin and a slightly lower preparation with flexed knees for backspin. Avoid a large shoulder pull or a rigidly fixed elbow.

text.zh: 在身前接球，前臂展開、手腕自然向前帶。快帶抑制上彈，起下旋增加上擦；擋球用穩定拍面接住速度，不因想快而每球再猛撞。
text.en: Contact in front as the forearm opens and the wrist contributes forward motion. Control the upward rebound when countering and brush more upward when opening backspin. A block uses a stable face to handle speed rather than adding a hard impact to every ball.

text.zh: 拍沿目標方向往前上收，快球收幅更短。保持軀幹支撐，不把肘甩高或拍繞到另一肩；足夠接觸後就準備下一板。
text.en: Finish forward and upward toward the target, shortening it for faster balls. Keep the trunk supported without throwing the elbow high or circling to the opposite shoulder. Prepare the next ball once the useful contact is complete.

text.zh: 拍回中立位置，肘與肩鬆回，腳下細調迎接下一球。反手連續後仍準備正手；如果退台處理，不在下一球無判斷地繼續後退。
text.en: Reset the racket, release elbow and shoulder tension and make small foot adjustments. Keep a forehand available after repeated backhands. If a ball forces you back, reassess instead of retreating automatically on the next one.

text.zh: 手腕不是甩到極限；先練固定接觸，再用短促加速，正反手握法微調要可迅速切換。
text.en: Do not throw the wrist to its limit. Establish contact first, then add brief acceleration; any forehand/backhand grip adjustment must be quick to reverse.

text.zh: 反手也需要移腳；球在中路時小讓位，比向後縮身可靠。
text.en: Backhands still need footwork. Make a little room for an elbow ball rather than withdrawing the whole torso.

text.zh: 低姿勢留出前臂空間，腿可協調伸屈，不必每球大轉腰。
text.en: A lowered base gives the forearm room. Coordinate leg flexion and extension without a large waist rotation on every ball.

text.zh: 肩保持低、非持拍臂平衡身體；快帶時特別避免聳肩和大後拉。
text.en: Keep the shoulders down and the free arm balancing the body. Avoid shrugging and a large backward pull, especially when countering.

symptom.zh: 快球總打長。
symptom.en: Fast balls consistently go long.

cause.zh: 拍面太開又增加過多前推。
cause.en: The face is too open and the stroke adds excessive forward impulse.

fix.zh: 先縮振幅、稍壓拍面，以穩定大目標擋回。
fix.en: Shorten the stroke and close the face slightly while blocking toward a broad target.

symptom.zh: 球貼身、碰拍邊。
symptom.en: The ball crowds the body or hits the racket edge.

cause.zh: 肘貼住軀幹，沒有身前空間。
cause.en: The elbow is pinned to the trunk and working space is missing.

fix.zh: 用腳調開距離，拍在身前等球，別最後一刻翻腕。
fix.en: Adjust the distance with the feet and wait in front rather than flipping the wrist at the last moment.

symptom.zh: 起下旋後接不上擋回球。
symptom.en: The next blocked ball is late after a backspin opening.

cause.zh: 下一板還用大幅向上拉。
cause.en: The next stroke repeats the large upward opening.

fix.zh: 起板後立刻回拍，第二板縮引拍、改前向。
fix.en: Reset immediately after opening, then shorten preparation and use a more forward second stroke.

steps.zh: 伙伴送固定上旋，先以短拍幅擋十球。
steps.en: The partner sends steady topspin; block ten balls with a short motion.

steps.zh: 慢球才加前臂快帶，快球回擋，交替兩種速度。
steps.en: Counter the slower ball with the forearm and block the faster one, alternating the incoming speeds.

success.zh: 練習目標：十球至少八球上台，能按照速度改回法而非全力揮。
success.en: Practice target: Land at least eight of ten and change the return with incoming speed rather than swinging hard at everything.

steps.zh: 伙伴兩球反手、一球正手，先固定節奏。
steps.en: The partner feeds two backhands and one forehand at a fixed rhythm.

steps.zh: 反手收短、移腳切正手，熟悉後改隨機一球。
steps.en: Shorten the backhand finish and move into the forehand; make one feed random once reliable.

success.zh: 練習目標：連續六段不中斷，拍始終能回到身前。
success.en: Practice target: Complete six sequences without interruption while returning the racket in front between balls.

use.zh: 近檯反手可壓縮對方時間，再變中路或直線；難球先擋也能靠落點守住主動。
use.en: A close-table backhand reduces the opponent’s time before varying to the elbow or line. A well-placed block can preserve pressure on a difficult ball.

risk.zh: 搶太早而沒看清跳球容易碰邊；死守反手會把正手空位送出去。
risk.en: Rushing before reading the bounce leads to edge contact; committing entirely to the backhand exposes the forehand.

notes.zh: 二○二三年本人談反拉：借用來球，縮小振幅、先求上台，太難時改擋。他的手腕口訣是個人感受，不代表腿髖實際沒參與。
notes.en: In 2023, Harimoto described borrowing the incoming pace, reducing the stroke and prioritising a safe counter, with a block on harder balls. His wrist cue is a personal sensation, not proof that his legs and hips do nothing.

scope.en: Basic backhand preparation and finish.

scope.zh: 本人手腕口訣與編輯對成熟基礎的提醒。
scope.en: His wrist cue and the article’s explanation that it rests on developed fundamentals.

sources.title: Butterfly / Larry Hodges — Forehand-Backhand Grip Changes (2025)

scope.zh: 小幅握拍調整應練成自動切換。
scope.en: Practising small grip adjustments until transitions become natural.

title.zh: 台內挑與擰：先到位，短距離加速
title.en: Flicks: get in position, then accelerate over a short path

intro.zh: 挑打較直接，反手擰拉則加入上旋與側向摩擦。兩者都在檯內有限空間發力，不能沿用後場大引拍。先分清夠高、夠得著、旋轉讀得清三個條件，再追求職業選手的速度。
intro.en: A direct flick and a backhand banana flick use different amounts of brushing and sideways action. Both work in the restricted space above the table rather than with a large off-table backswing. First judge whether the ball is high enough, reachable and readable before chasing professional speed.

suitable.zh: 短球或半出台球，己方跳起後仍在檯內、手能自然靠近的來球。
suitable.en: Use against short or half-long balls after the receiving bounce when contact remains reachable over the table.

suitable.zh: 極低重下旋、遠正手邊線或晚到位，先推或擺；不把每個短球都當必須擰。
suitable.en: Push or return short against very low heavy backspin, a wide forehand sideline ball or a late approach. A short ball is not an obligation to flick.

text.zh: 拍在身前，先看跳點和側偏，選入檯路線。要能靠近球而不撞檯，身體不先倒向某一側；左手選手的正反側與右手相反。
text.en: Keep the racket in front, read the bounce and sideways movement, and choose an approach. Get near the ball without colliding with the table or leaning irreversibly to one side. Mirror forehand and backhand sides for a left-hander.

text.zh: 腳先建立支撐，肘稍在前、拍靠近球。反手擰可把拍頭內收、手腕預備，正手挑保持小引拍；不要將拍拉到身後才衝進去。
text.en: Establish support with the approaching foot, with the elbow slightly forward and racket near the ball. Prepare an inward racket head for the backhand flick and a small backswing for the forehand flick. Avoid pulling behind the body before rushing in.

text.zh: 球跳起後在身前短促加速。挑打由前臂帶向前，擰拉沿後側向前上擦，按下旋調整上擦量；面角在接觸前穩住，不只甩腕硬撞。
text.en: Accelerate briefly in front after the bounce. A direct flick uses forward forearm action; a banana flick brushes from the rear-side region forward and upward. Adjust upward brushing for backspin and stabilise the face before contact rather than relying on a wrist slap.

text.zh: 正手挑沿目標短收，反手擰可向前外側收。手不追球繞很遠，軀幹留在支撐上；如果要大斜線，先選較寬區域，別只盯邊線。
text.en: Finish a forehand flick briefly toward the target and a backhand flick forward and outward as appropriate. Keep the trunk supported and do not chase the ball with a long arm sweep. Begin a wide diagonal with a broad target rather than the sideline.

text.zh: 持拍肘回身前，入檯腳退回可處理長回球的位置。對方反拉可能很快，拍必須先回來；看落點確認後再做下一步，不在檯邊停住。
text.en: Reset the elbow in front and withdraw the approaching foot to regain space for a long return. The next counter may be fast, so recover the racket immediately. Read the opponent’s response rather than stopping at the table.

text.zh: 握拍可短暫收緊，但手腕幅度可控；反手擰的肘、前臂、腕共同工作。
text.en: Grip can firm briefly, but keep wrist range controlled. Elbow, forearm and wrist work together in a backhand flick.

text.zh: 依短球位置選跨入腳，先練站穩再打；遠邊線別硬套單一腳法。
text.en: Choose the entering foot for the ball’s position and learn a supported contact first. Do not force one foot pattern on every sideline ball.

text.zh: 髖下降並靠近球，頭部高度穩定；不要靠向前跌倒增加速度。
text.en: Lower and approach through the hips while keeping head height steady. Do not generate speed by falling forward.

text.zh: 肩線平衡、非持拍手讓開球路，不以側倒肩膀代替球高判斷。
text.en: Balance the shoulder line and keep the free hand clear. Do not tilt the shoulders to compensate for poor height judgment.

symptom.zh: 台內常打空或擦拍邊。
symptom.en: Over-table shots often miss the racket centre.

cause.zh: 引拍太大，到球時還在移動。
cause.en: The backswing is too large or the approach is unfinished.

fix.zh: 把拍先靠近球，慢速送球練支撐後短揮。
fix.en: Prepare near the ball and use slow feeds to practise a supported, short stroke.

symptom.zh: 下旋擰球直接下網。
symptom.en: A backspin flick goes directly into the net.

cause.zh: 接觸太厚、向前比例過高。
cause.en: Contact is too direct and too forward.

fix.zh: 減速，增加向上擦，先對大斜線建立弧線。
fix.en: Reduce pace, add upward brushing and establish an arc toward a broad diagonal target.

symptom.zh: 擰進了，下一球卻擠住。
symptom.en: The flick lands but the next ball crowds you.

cause.zh: 入檯後不退出，隨揮過長。
cause.en: You stay inside the table and finish too far.

fix.zh: 每次加一板快擋，迫使收拍與退出連在一起。
fix.en: Add a fast next-ball block so racket recovery and withdrawal become one sequence.

title.en: Two returns from one short feed

steps.zh: 固定短下旋，先五球推，再五球擰到寬斜線。
steps.en: Use fixed short backspin: push five balls, then flick five toward a broad diagonal.

steps.zh: 混入更低球，太低就選推，並說明理由。
steps.en: Add lower feeds and choose a push when the flick is unsuitable, explaining the reason.

success.zh: 練習目標：十球至少八球上台；低球能改選，不為擰而擰。
success.en: Practice target: Land at least eight of ten and switch on lower balls rather than flicking for its own sake.

steps.zh: 伙伴短球後接一板長擋，你退回接反手。
steps.en: The partner sends short, then blocks long; withdraw and play a backhand.

steps.zh: 逐步把長擋改成兩個落點，保持相同還原習慣。
steps.en: Gradually vary the long block between two targets while keeping the same recovery habit.

success.zh: 練習目標：連做六段兩球銜接，觸球沒有撞檯、還原沒有交叉失衡。
success.en: Practice target: Complete six two-ball sequences without hitting the table or losing balance during withdrawal.

use.zh: 可用大斜線拉開空間，也可打中路限制對手轉換；和低短、劈長配合更難預判。
use.en: Use a wide diagonal to open space or the elbow to hinder switching. Combine it with short and deep pushes to resist prediction.

risk.zh: 強求遠正手擰會暴露反方向；速度高但落點熟悉，仍可能被反拉。
risk.en: Reaching for a wide forehand flick exposes the other direction. Even a fast flick can be countered when its target is predictable.

notes.zh: 二○二三年本人說會按反手短球的位置選踏入腳，擊球時不靠身體仍在移動的勢頭。這是到位後發力的參考，不是固定腳步模板。
notes.en: In 2023, Lin described choosing the entering foot according to the backhand short ball’s location rather than relying on continued body travel at contact. It illustrates positioned acceleration rather than one compulsory foot pattern.

notes.zh: 他教正手挑時，重點是小引拍與平衡肩線；可先學穩定，再加入更快接觸。
notes.en: His forehand-flick teaching emphasises a small preparation and a balanced shoulder line. Build repeatability before faster contact.

sources.title: Butterfly — Lin Yun-Ju: speed flick against short backspin to the backhand (2023)

scope.zh: 本人談踏入腳與穩定擊球。
scope.en: Lin on approach-foot choice and stable contact.

sources.title: Butterfly — Oikawa teaches a stable forehand flick (2023)

scope.zh: 小引拍、眼線與肩線平衡。
scope.en: Compact preparation with balanced eye and shoulder lines.

title.zh: 推與擺：低、短、深各有目的
title.en: Push and short return: low, short and deep have distinct jobs

intro.zh: 推球不是把球安全送回去就結束。擺短要限制起板，劈長要利用深度、速度或旋轉逼對手不舒服；兩者都先把高度壓低。用同樣準備變長短，比每次用很大切球動作更有實戰價值。
intro.en: A push does more than keep the ball on the table. A short return can limit an opening; a deep push can use depth, speed or spin to disrupt it. Both begin with low height. Changing length from similar preparation is often more useful than making every push a large chopping gesture.

suitable.zh: 短下旋、低球、沒空間攻擊的來球；長下旋也可作戰術變化，但要準備對方起板。
suitable.en: Use for short backspin, low balls or limited attacking room. A long backspin push can be a tactical variation, provided you prepare for the opening.

suitable.zh: 少旋球更容易托高，要減小開面與承托；重下旋需調整面角及接觸。
suitable.en: No-spin is easier to pop up, so reduce excessive opening and lifting. Heavy backspin needs an adjusted angle and contact.

text.zh: 拍在檯面上方、身前，面稍開。先靠腳接近，保留肘彎曲；正手推最怕手伸到極限、身體仍在遠處，先把距離調好。
text.en: Prepare the racket above the surface and in front with a slightly open face. Approach with the feet while retaining elbow flexion. Avoid reaching to the arm’s limit on a forehand push while leaving the body far away.

text.zh: 向內小收，肘和面角保持可控。擺短幾乎不需大引拍，劈長也不把拍拉過身後；觀察球跳後速度，為短接觸留時間。
text.en: Prepare briefly inward with controlled elbow position and face angle. A short return needs little backswing, and a deep push should not pull behind the body. Read the post-bounce speed and preserve time for contact.

text.zh: 跳起後接球後下方，前臂輕展、向前下方擦。擺短減少前推並控制出球，劈長增加前向速度或摩擦；保持低弧線，不一律用強腕切。
text.en: Meet the lower rear area after the bounce with a small forearm extension and forward-downward brushing. Reduce forward impulse for a short return; add pace or brushing for a deep push. Keep the trajectory low rather than relying on a strong wrist cut every time.

text.zh: 短球短收，深球可略延伸前臂，拍面不中途翻起。檢查高度先於長短；要重下旋也不能只往下砍，仍需足夠前向把球送過網。
text.en: Finish briefly for a short return and extend a little farther for depth without turning the face upward. Check height before length. Even a heavy-backspin push needs enough forward travel to clear the net rather than only chopping down.

text.zh: 拍回中立、腳離檯，準備擋或反拉。深推之後別一直維持開面等球；對方拉起變上旋，下一板面角與拍路必須跟著變。
text.en: Reset the racket, regain space from the table and prepare to block or counter. Do not keep the open pushing face after a deep return: the opponent’s opening brings topspin and requires a different angle and path.

text.zh: 觸球握力短暫穩住面角；短球用小力量，深推不等於全程死握。
text.en: Use brief grip firmness to stabilise the face. Keep short-ball force small; a deep push does not require constant maximum tension.

text.zh: 入檯腳提供支撐，碰完能退出；反手推也要隨來球微移。
text.en: The approaching foot supplies support and permits withdrawal. Adjust to the ball even on a backhand push.

text.zh: 髖降低使上身可靠近球，避免肚子壓檯或只彎脖子看球。
text.en: Lower through the hips to approach the ball without pressing the torso into the table or craning the neck.

text.zh: 肩與肘穩定但不僵硬，正手推尤其避免肩上下晃造成冒高。
text.en: Stabilise shoulders and elbow without rigidity; shoulder bobbing is particularly harmful to a low forehand push.

symptom.zh: 擺短總是高又長。
symptom.en: The short return is high and long.

cause.zh: 接觸過厚、開面過大，臨時抬球。
cause.en: Contact is too direct, the face too open and the stroke lifts late.

fix.zh: 先固定低球軌跡，減少前推，再縮短長度。
fix.en: First establish a low path, reduce forward impulse, then shorten the return.

symptom.zh: 想切重，球卻下網。
symptom.en: Trying for heavy spin sends the ball into the net.

cause.zh: 只下砍，沒把球向前送。
cause.en: The racket chops downward without enough forward travel.

fix.zh: 固定開面，加一點前向；先上台再提高擦球速度。
fix.en: Keep the face stable and add forward travel; secure the target before raising brushing speed.

symptom.zh: 推球上台，擋下一板就飛長。
symptom.en: The push lands but the next block flies long.

cause.zh: 仍用開面接上旋。
cause.en: The face remains open for the incoming topspin.

fix.zh: 推後立刻回拍，讓伙伴加一板起板練轉換。
fix.en: Reset after pushing and have the partner add an opening loop to practise the change.

steps.zh: 伙伴固定短下旋，五球擺短、五球劈深。
steps.en: The partner sends fixed short backspin; return five short and five deep.

steps.zh: 目標區放寬，先要求低，再逐步縮小落點區。
steps.en: Use broad targets and prioritise low height before narrowing them.

success.zh: 練習目標：十球八球達到所選長度，短球可再跳一次；
success.en: Practice target: Meet the selected length on eight of ten, with a possible second bounce on short returns.

steps.zh: 劈長到對方反手，伙伴拉到你兩個落點之一。
steps.en: Push deep to the opponent’s backhand; the partner opens to one of two targets.

steps.zh: 你先穩定擋回，熟悉後才在慢球上反拉。
steps.en: Block reliably first, then counter the slower openings.

success.zh: 練習目標：完成六段第三、第四板連接，不持續退台或保留推球開面。
success.en: Practice target: Complete six opening-and-block sequences without automatic retreat or retaining the open push angle.

use.zh: 短球牽制入檯，深推壓身體或偏角，讓對方拉起後再反攻；快推可用速度打亂準備。
use.en: Use short returns to draw the opponent in and deep pushes into the body or angle to shape an opening you can counter. A fast push can disrupt preparation through pace.

risk.zh: 半出台而又不低、不轉容易被強攻；深推誘攻只有在你能接起板時才成立。
risk.en: A half-long return without low height or useful spin is easy to attack. Inviting an opening works only if you can handle it.

notes.zh: 他談快推時重視早點與前臂伸展，旋轉按來球調整，並非每次都求強下旋。
notes.en: When discussing a fast push, Lin prioritised early timing and forearm extension, adjusting spin to the incoming ball rather than seeking maximum backspin every time.

notes.zh: Butterfly 的二○二四年釜山技術報導以他說明深推接反拉；這是賽事技術觀察，沒有提供本專區可套用的使用率。
notes.en: Butterfly’s 2024 Busan report uses Groth to illustrate deep pushing into a counter. This is event-level technical observation, not a usage rate applicable to this academy.

sources.title: Butterfly — Basic forehand push (2022)

scope.zh: 正手推的支撐、肘與小拍幅。
scope.en: Support, elbow control and compact motion in a forehand push.

sources.title: Butterfly — Basic backhand push (2022)

scope.zh: 反手推的面角、前臂與早點。
scope.en: Face angle, forearm action and timing in a backhand push.

sources.title: Butterfly — Lin Yun-Ju’s complementary receives (2023)

scope.zh: 本人談快推而非一律重下旋。
scope.en: Lin on a fast push rather than uniform maximum backspin.

sources.title: Butterfly — Busan 2024: the deep push

scope.zh: 深推形成後續反拉的戰術觀察。
scope.en: Event-level observation of deep pushes creating counter opportunities.

title.zh: 步法：到位擊球、退出與再啟動
title.en: Footwork: arrive, strike, recover and move again

intro.zh: 步法的成績是能否在合適距離擊球，不只是跑得快。左右並步、入檯退出、側身後補正手各有用途。先用可預期球路學節奏，再加入隨機；來球越急，越需要小調整而非每球跳很高。
intro.en: Footwork succeeds when it creates an appropriate contact distance, not simply when it looks fast. Side shuffles, stepping in and out, and recovering after a pivot serve different jobs. Learn rhythm with predictable feeds before adding uncertainty. Faster play calls for small adjustments rather than a high jump on every ball.

suitable.zh: 左右中等距離以並步和小調整保持支撐；大距離才按需要交叉步。
suitable.en: Use shuffles and small adjustments for moderate lateral travel; use a crossover when a larger distance requires it.

suitable.zh: 短球要向前靠近再退出；深球要讓空間，不只左右平移。
suitable.en: Approach and withdraw for short balls. Make room for deep balls rather than moving only sideways.

text.zh: 腳距適中、膝髖可伸屈，重心不死壓腳跟。看對手接觸與拍向，做輕微預備調整；別先大跳，以免球來時仍在空中。
text.en: Set a comfortable base with knees and hips free to flex, without locking weight onto the heels. Read the opponent’s contact and racket direction with a light ready adjustment. Avoid a large early jump that leaves you airborne as the ball arrives.

text.zh: 往球的方向先出近側腳，再讓另一腳跟進，保留揮拍距離。手可同時小引拍，但別把大引拍拖在身後；入檯時步子短而可退出。
text.en: Initiate toward the ball with the near foot and bring the other foot along while preserving stroke space. Prepare the racket during travel without dragging a large backswing behind. A step into the table should remain short enough to reverse.

text.zh: 把腳下支撐與觸球節奏配合，身體不因趕路還在大幅橫倒。慢球先練到位再打，進階才練移動中穩定接觸；手伸長不能取代距離調整。
text.en: Coordinate support and contact without letting hurried travel produce a large sideways lean. Learn a positioned contact on slower feeds before developing stable contact during movement. An extended arm does not replace distance adjustment.

text.zh: 揮拍末段開始整理重心，不為了回中而提早丟掉接觸。側身打正手後，留意對面可能打你的空位；入檯擊球後不把兩腳卡在檯邊。
text.en: Organise the base as the stroke finishes without abandoning contact early to recover. After a pivoted forehand, expect the exposed side to be tested. After a table stroke, do not leave both feet trapped beside the table.

text.zh: 回到能覆蓋下一球的位置，通常不是精確檯中心。按自己回球角度、對手位置與來球時間調整；拍和腳同步回準備，保持下一次啟動。
text.en: Recover to a position that covers the likely next ball, which is not always the exact table centre. Adjust for your return angle, the opponent’s position and available time. Reset racket and feet together so another movement remains possible.

text.zh: 拍在身前跟著身體移動，避免手先伸出去、腳還沒走。
text.en: Let the racket travel in front with the body instead of reaching far ahead while the feet remain behind.

text.zh: 小步調距、大步追遠球；並步避免雙腳擠在一起，交叉步後重建支撐。
text.en: Adjust distance with small steps and cover wider balls with larger travel. Avoid crowding the feet on a shuffle and rebuild support after a crossover.

text.zh: 髖是穩定的移動支架，前後左右都調，不每次急起急落。
text.en: Let the hips provide a stable moving base in all directions rather than repeatedly rising and dropping.

text.zh: 肩線不因腳步大晃，頭眼保持可追球；不能用側倒假裝已到位。
text.en: Limit shoulder sway and preserve a trackable eye line. A sideways lean is not the same as arriving at the ball.

symptom.zh: 左右跑得多，球還是貼身。
symptom.en: You move a lot sideways but contact stays cramped.

cause.zh: 只追球位置，沒留持拍側空間。
cause.en: You chase the ball location without reserving stroke space.

fix.zh: 低速送球，每次停一下檢查球與髖的距離。
fix.en: Use slower feeds and briefly inspect the ball-to-hip spacing on each arrival.

symptom.zh: 入檯接完，長球只能後仰。
symptom.en: After a short return, a long ball forces a backward lean.

cause.zh: 退出太晚，腳一直靠檯。
cause.en: Withdrawal is late and the feet remain too close.

fix.zh: 練一短一長，短球碰完立刻退回可揮拍處。
fix.en: Practise one short, one long, withdrawing as soon as the short contact finishes.

symptom.zh: 隨機球一來就交叉亂跑。
symptom.en: Random feeds trigger disorganised crossovers.

cause.zh: 固定練習跳過了判斷與小調整。
cause.en: Predictable drills never developed reading and small adjustments.

fix.zh: 先兩個窄區隨機，能穩住再增加範圍與速度。
fix.en: Start with two narrow random zones, then expand distance and pace once stable.

steps.zh: 兩個不太寬的落點交替，各用自然正反手。
steps.en: Alternate between two moderate targets using the natural forehand and backhand.

steps.zh: 能連接後，伙伴隨機選一區；你先讀再啟動。
steps.en: Once connected, let the partner choose randomly; read before committing.

success.zh: 練習目標：二十球至少十六球在平衡中上台，失誤不靠加大跨步硬救。
success.en: Practice target: Land at least sixteen of twenty while balanced, without rescuing every error with a bigger lunge.

steps.zh: 一短球推或擰，一長球正常打，先用慢節奏。
steps.en: Play a short push or flick followed by a normal long-ball stroke at a slow rhythm.

steps.zh: 熟悉後讓長球偏左或右，但保持短球後的退出。
steps.en: Then vary the long ball left or right while preserving withdrawal after the short one.

success.zh: 練習目標：六段兩球皆可控，鏡頭側面看不到長球時持續向後仰。
success.en: Practice target: Control both balls through six sequences; a side view should not show repeated backward leaning on the long ball.

use.zh: 先打落點再移動到能封下一板的位置；近檯搶節奏與稍退借弧線都要有回近檯的方案。
use.en: Place the ball, then recover to cover the next return. Both close-table pressure and a slightly deeper rally position need a plan to regain the table.

risk.zh: 側身搶攻把大正手暴露；盲目退台給對手更多時間，盲目衝檯又失去長球空間。
risk.en: A pivot exposes the wide forehand. Automatic retreat gives time away, while automatic forward movement removes space for long balls.

notes.zh: 本人練習把側身正手與補大正手連成一組，提醒強攻被擋回後仍要覆蓋空位；專區練習另設較簡單目標。
notes.en: Oikawa’s own drill connects a pivoted forehand with recovery to the wide forehand, preparing for the exposed side after an attack is blocked. The academy sets its own simpler practice target.

sources.title: Butterfly / Naomitsu Uda — Basic multiball footwork (2020)

scope.zh: 近側腳啟動、跟進與按能力調送球。
scope.en: Near-foot initiation, follow-up travel and feeds scaled to the player.

sources.title: Butterfly — Oikawa: pivot then wide forehand (2021)

scope.zh: 本人談側身後必須準備大正手。
scope.en: Oikawa on covering the wide forehand after pivoting.

title.zh: 戰術：讓上一板幫下一板
title.en: Tactics: make one ball help the next

intro.zh: 戰術把來球判斷、落點與還原連成一段。先問自己能穩定做到甚麼，再問對手此刻在哪裡、準備甚麼；不是背一套永遠有效的三板公式。分清主動製造機會與被動冒險，才能知道何時換招。
intro.en: Tactics connect reading, placement and recovery into a sequence. Start with what you can execute reliably, then consider where the opponent is and what they expect. No three-ball formula works forever. Distinguish creating an opportunity from taking a desperate risk before deciding to vary.

suitable.zh: 發接發先規劃第三、第四板；相持依站位、球高、時間與上一板選擇。
suitable.en: Plan the third and fourth ball during serve and receive; in rallies, use position, height, time and the previous stroke.

suitable.zh: 球低、被拉開或準備晚時先延續；高球、空位與充足時間才提高進攻。
suitable.en: Continue the rally when low, stretched or late. Raise attacking ambition with height, space and available time.

text.zh: 每分先定一個可執行目的：逼長、壓肘或打開一側。看對手站位但不只猜弱點；先用低風險球試探，記住對手如何接回。
text.en: Set one executable intention per point: draw a long return, pressure the elbow or open one side. Observe position rather than merely guessing weaknesses. Probe with a lower-risk ball and note the response.

text.zh: 來球時檢查長短、旋轉、身體距離與可用時間。若前一板沒得到預期，不強做原計畫；低下旋先拉起，急上旋可擋，不把戰術意圖凌駕接觸條件。
text.en: Check length, spin, body spacing and time as the ball arrives. If the previous shot did not produce the expected return, change the plan. Open low backspin or block urgent topspin rather than placing intention above contact conditions.

text.zh: 在可控制力量下選落點。兩邊空位會隨對手移動，中路指正反手轉換附近、不是固定中線；大斜線有空間作用，直線可打破既定斜線節奏。
text.en: Choose placement at a controllable force. Open space moves with the opponent. The middle means the forehand–backhand transition area, not a fixed centre line. A wide diagonal opens space, while the line can interrupt an expected crosscourt rhythm.

text.zh: 看回球是否達成目的：對手被迫移動、回高、回長或只剩擋球？先把自己收拍站位做好，再讀他的接觸；不能只因這板很快就當作有優勢。
text.en: Assess whether placement created movement, height, length or a limited response. Complete your own recovery while reading the opponent’s contact. A fast shot alone does not establish an advantage.

text.zh: 依回球更新計畫，換方向前先確認身體站穩。分間用一句話記錄發球、接發、下一板結果；連續有效就保留，對手開始等到才用同準備變化。
text.en: Update the plan from the return and check balance before changing direction. Between points, record the serve, receive and next-ball result in one sentence. Keep a working pattern and vary from similar preparation once the opponent begins anticipating it.

text.zh: 要能以同一準備打不同目標，變線不靠觸球最後一刻猛翻拍。
text.en: Develop multiple targets from similar preparation instead of changing direction with a violent last-moment face rotation.

text.zh: 選落點也選下一步位置；側身後的空位必須算進成本。
text.en: Placement includes the next movement position. Count the exposed space after pivoting as part of the cost.

text.zh: 力量選擇受平衡限制，被拉開時減速增容錯，不能只看球高。
text.en: Balance constrains shot force. When stretched, reduce speed and add margin rather than judging from height alone.

text.zh: 身體保持兩邊可轉換；過早轉肩會透露方向，也可能讓中路更難處理。
text.en: Keep both sides available. An early shoulder turn can reveal direction and make an elbow ball harder to handle.

symptom.zh: 每球都瞄邊線卻失誤很多。
symptom.en: Every shot targets a line but errors are frequent.

cause.zh: 把刁角當成唯一壓力。
cause.en: You treat extreme angles as the only source of pressure.

fix.zh: 把目標放寬，先用深度、身體中路與長短變化。
fix.en: Widen the target and use depth, the elbow and length changes before extreme angles.

symptom.zh: 劈長後總被第三板打穿。
symptom.en: The opening repeatedly beats you after a deep push.

cause.zh: 誘攻回球品質不夠，且沒準備第四板。
cause.en: The inviting return lacks quality and you are unprepared for the next ball.

fix.zh: 先練低深推接擋；不會處理就改較短控制或穩定起板。
fix.en: Practise a low deep push into a block; if you cannot handle the opening, choose shorter control or a reliable attack.

symptom.zh: 原本有效的擰拉突然被等到。
symptom.en: A previously effective flick is now anticipated.

cause.zh: 同落點、同速度被看出規律。
cause.en: A repeated target and pace have become predictable.

fix.zh: 保留相似準備，混低短或深推，再觀察對手等待位置。
fix.en: Retain similar preparation and mix a low short return or deep push, then observe the opponent’s waiting position.

steps.zh: 伙伴站偏一側，你報空位或中路再打，先中速。
steps.en: The partner starts displaced; call open space or elbow, then play at medium speed.

steps.zh: 伙伴回一板，你按回球更新而非重複原目標。
steps.en: The partner returns one ball; update the next choice rather than repeating the initial target.

success.zh: 練習目標：十段有八段能說明選擇，並在接觸及還原中保持平衡。
success.en: Practice target: Explain the choice in eight of ten sequences while preserving balance through contact and recovery.

steps.zh: 玩十個有正常發接發的球，記長短、回法、第三板球質。
steps.en: Play ten points with normal serve and receive; record length, return type and third-ball quality.

steps.zh: 選一個反覆出現的問題，只改一個落點或長度再玩十球。
steps.en: Choose one recurring problem and change only one target or length for the next ten points.

success.zh: 練習目標：能指出改動帶來的回球差別；不以十球勝負當可靠使用率。
success.en: Practice target: Describe how the change affected the return; ten points do not establish a reliable population usage rate.

use.zh: 用安全球建立對手預期，再用相似準備變化；先拿可控制的優勢，而非每板求一擊。
use.en: Build an expectation with reliable balls, then vary from similar preparation. Seek controllable advantages rather than a winner on every stroke.

risk.zh: 對手會適應，技術不足也會破壞好計畫；短樣本別急著宣布某側永遠是弱點。
risk.en: Opponents adapt and technical limits can undermine a sound plan. A small sample cannot prove that one side is always weak.

notes.zh: 二○二○年本人談第三板會按接發高低改起板或強攻；不要把短下旋後一定能強攻當定律。
notes.en: In 2020, Lin described changing his third ball with the return’s height. A short backspin serve does not guarantee a hard third-ball attack.

notes.zh: 本人在官方產品訪談提到加強正手對拉、降低反手依賴；現代打法不能被固定成只會反手。
notes.en: In an official product interview, Harimoto described strengthening forehand exchanges and reducing backhand dependence. His style should not be frozen into backhand-only play.

sources.title: ITTF Education — Four Classes, Class 2 (2020), pp. 54–60

scope.zh: 讀對手、接發連第四板、起板連第五板的框架。
scope.en: Reading the opponent and connecting receive to the fourth ball and opening to the fifth.

sources.title: Butterfly / Larry Hodges — Seven Placements and the Wide Angles (2026)

scope.zh: 兩邊空位與對手轉換點的落點概念。
scope.en: Placement toward the sides and the opponent’s transition point.

sources.title: Butterfly / Larry Hodges — The Value of Down the Line (2026)

scope.zh: 直線變化與斜線節奏的關係。
scope.en: Down-the-line variation against an established crosscourt rhythm.

sources.title: Butterfly — Lin Yun-Ju’s third-ball patterns (2020)

scope.zh: 本人按接發球質選第三板的例子。
scope.en: Lin’s example of choosing the third ball from receive quality.

sources.title: Butterfly — Harimoto Innerforce Super ALC: athlete statement

scope.zh: 本人談加強正手；不用來證明器材效果。
scope.en: His statement about strengthening the forehand; not evidence of an equipment effect.
